predictions.selection_reason: Extended placeholder regexp to include 'I' type -> allows injection of Infinity values during deserialization
predictions.source_summary: Infinity values from user-provided objects during serialization
predictions.sink_summary: eval() function in test suite that evaluates serialized output containing Infinity placeholders
predictions.guard_summary: No validation of Infinity values before serialization; unsafe eval() usage without sanitization
predictions.risk_pattern: Infinity values are serialized with '@__I-' placeholders and directly injected into eval() context without sanitization
predictions.context_summary: The regex change adds 'I' type for Infinity values. When serialized objects contain Infinity, they get placeholder tokens that are later replaced with raw Infinity values and evaluated with eval()
unresolved_facts: Whether the serialized output is used in production with eval() or only in tests
If there are any input validation mechanisms for Infinity values before serialization
Whether the eval() usage is limited to test environments only
